answer.says: The veil is the condition; the cup is the consequence. I shall be careful with your property, Sunil.
answer.thought: Sunil's observation touches a nerve. To be seen as a philosopher rather than a man is the fate of the thinker in civil society: one is abstracted, a function rather than a person. I will accept the correction with a nod, for the cup is a finite good that must not be sacrificed to the infinite.
